title: Classic gateway: instance pools refused, and node types stay PENDING

found.by: expected-entry test round 2026-10-25: SQL Server 2022 CU27, classic workspace

symptom: Instance pool create: "You are not authorized to create instance pools." Classic gateways on m5.large and m6g.large stayed PENDING at "Finding instances" for 40 minutes or more.
cause: Not established: the user lacks pool permission; node availability wasn't checked.
fix: Ask a workspace admin for instance-pool permission, or run the gateway on serverless.
